epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce manual local environment setup time from >10 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Add docker-compose.yml to start the full stack and expose a health-check endpoint

slices.title: Create docker-compose.yml for full stack
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml, so that the product can be launched and verified locally
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root
When running docker-compose up
Then the full stack starts successfully
And a health-check endpoint is exposed and reachable
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce manual container startup commands from >3 to 1

epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce outdated material resolution time from >24 hours to <5 minutes
requirements: R1: Add UI actions to edit or delete existing materials that invoke existing API endpoints

slices.title: Implement update and delete UI for materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the frontend management for this epic, I want to patch the existing UI to add update and delete actions, so that outdated materials can be removed or corrected
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog
When a user clicks edit or delete
Then the frontend invokes the corresponding PUT or DELETE API
And the catalog view reflects the updated state
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce UI steps for material updates from >10 (manual api) to 2

epics.title: User Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthenticated system access incidents from >0 to 0 per month
requirements: R1: Enforce authentication and prompt unauthenticated users to log in before accessing the catalog or creating materials

slices.title: Enforce authentication on catalog and material creation
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to patch the existing codebase to enforce login, so that restricted data is protected
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user
When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material
Then they are blocked
And prompted to log in
